about: C1 (RELEASE_PLAN section 1): what may ship in the release executable, its DLLs and the package. Read by tools/player/composition_audit.py v3 (ledger release.composition). Every item needs a rule here; an unclassified item FAILS. First matching rule wins (path = exact root-relative path, glob = fnmatch, name = case-insensitive basename). Classes: ship = may ship; exclude = fails C1 (emulation, a development oracle, or a mixed unit that still contains either - split it or remove the alternative); review = an owner decision (listed, not failed); tool = a build tool / prerequisite (allowed only as a non-incorporated input of a producing edge, never read by a compile). `off` = the class under -DSR_ORACLE=0 (a unit compiled so; a content item only when every unit reading it was). `markers` = strings of an excluded rule that must not occur in a shipped binary (log tags; env-gate names end in NUL: an exact C string). A real header (.h .hh .hpp .hxx) with no content rule takes the EXACT path sources rule of its same-named .cpp (its `header` class for a mixed unit); .inc / .inl need their own rule. Generated items: `inputs` = the producing edge's inputs the item incorporates (verified against the edge and, for a preprocessing producer, the #include closure), `prerequisites` = inputs it does not; `produced` = how a build-dir file with no producing edge came to be (configure / link step). unresolved_includes: an include the audit's over-approximated closure cannot resolve in the trees, exempted for that exact name from that exact includer (with why); an exemption never hides a tree file. runtime_dlls: `system` DLLs need not be staged; a staged DLL is a closure build output or pinned here by `sha256`; `dynamic` = DLLs the code loads with LoadLibrary / COM (must be staged unless system). package: an executable needs an exact path rule; a link / junction needs `link`. link_steps: the PRE_LINK commands of the closure's linker edges (paths normalized to <build> / <src>). An environment gate does not make a component absent. Test instruments that grade the shipped binary itself (the harness input channel, present dumps, the freeze holds) are diag, not oracle: RELEASE_PLAN step 10 re-runs the gates on the final package.
